defaultPolicy: Human approval is required for consequential public, paid, destructive, or credential-changing actions.

read.notes: Read non-secret repo state, generated artifacts, workflow inventory, docs, and public-safe media metadata.

draft.notes: Create non-public concepts, scripts, render proofs, product metadata, queues, and tracking records.

workflow_edit.notes: Safe reversible workflow/template edits are allowed and must be documented.

workflow_execute.notes: Do not execute workflows that publish, spend money, change credentials, or touch production data without Daniel approval.

secretPolicy: Never expose passwords, API keys, OAuth access tokens, refresh tokens, service-account secrets, payment credentials, or private authentication material.
Credential health may be documented without secret values.
Use existing credential stores; do not move secrets into source code.
